sources.snippet: As a rule of thumb: Use the Light Microscopy model (vit_b_lm) for segmenting cells or nuclei in light microscopy. The larger model (vit_l_lm) yields a bit better segmentation quality, especially for automatic segmentation, but needs more computational resources. Use the Electron Microscopy models (vit_b_em_organelles or vit_l_em_organelles) for segmenting mitochondria, nuclei or other roundish ...
